If not, you simply let them go.

Own PA, music on in the breaks, no deposit, cash on the night.

A nice spread across the year would be:

Saturday 7 November 2026, confirmed
Saturday 27 March 2027, provisional

He does a great Christmas show, so the December night would be a real treat for the members.
